assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only 86-eighty-six:shinei-nouzen@original-light-novels#86-shinei-nouzen-character-reference-profile, the canonical CMR-4 Shinei Nouzen character reference profile (version 1.2, release 86-V2-V01-V14-1.0) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked original-Japanese light novels V01-V14, with Alter.1 as audited supplemental ordinary-life evidence and Alter.2 excluded. The project's corpus map and Character Modeling Reference method were read for method, authority order and scope only; the CMR-9 promotion audit, the diagnostic locator index, the relationship matrix, the crosswalk, the ledgers, the specialist documents, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The profile's CMR-9 verdict and its HIGH, MODERATE and OPEN confidence labels are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation, V15+ volume, Alter.2 scene or other character's profile is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Developmental states from the V01 Spearhead squadron period through the V14 boundary state, with Alter.1 scenes used only in the pre-Federacy and low-pressure placements the profile assigns them; the default is the V14 boundary state in which mature future language and unresolved role-based self-use coexist. States after V14, the resolution of the final arc, a postwar vocation, Undertaker after the war and the course of the V14 sensory loss are expressly not established, and no in-world calendar dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The profile states a reconstruction thesis (self-reduction into whatever function the situation requires; growth by semantic admission rather than stylistic transformation), seven baseline traits each with a confidence label and a counter-control, a behavioral grammar (attention, observe-narrow-test-act sequence, intervention threshold, premise-oriented decision style, failure and repair style), values restated as conduct, 24 mischaracterization traps and a ten-row counterexample audit with SURVIVES/NARROW/DOWNGRADE dispositions. The claims are located to volume, EPUB route and Phase-5 locator. It is one derived reference artifact whose narrower authorities (L01, Document 02) lie outside this evidence set, and its promotion gates are the project's own; no independent reconstruction test is in the set, so A is not supported.

Section XIV traces V01 (competent carrier with no self-authored future) through V02 civilian capacity, V03 peer-forced return planning, V04 legitimate dependency, V05-V06 abandonment petition, V07 confession, V08 non-exclusive identity, V09 procedural self-monitoring, V10-V11 bounded Undertaker, V12-V13 non-sufficient competence and the V14 coexistence of mature future language with sensory-loss concealment, each tied to located scenes (V01-L008, V03-L022, V04-L032, V06-L036, V07-L054, V08-L031/L032/L034, V09-L004, V10-L059/L060, V12-L028/L029, V13-L085/L089, V14-L044/L055/L059/L061/L147/L197/L199). The semantic-admission sequence orders fourteen attested lines. The profile forbids a completed healed-Shin model and leaves the final arc open. Granularity is volume-level; the ordering of Alter.1 scenes against the mainline is only partly fixed.

Section V records a written-Japanese fingerprint: おれ as first person; plain clipped peer speech with お前 compatible with trust; sustained です/ます toward Lena across procedure, disagreement, extraction requests, abandonment fear, confession and domestic exchanges; 少佐/大佐 giving way to レーナ without eliminating role register; no deference to Frederica; ellipsis as default; politeness that carries refusal (聞けません); and a fourteen-line attested semantic-admission sequence plus located humor lines (それと、誰がお兄ちゃんだ; 遠慮しなくてもいいのに; 試すようなことはやめてくれ; 一人きりじゃ戦えない、弱い死神だから; 助けてくれ). This supports recognition and constraint of register by interlocutor and state. Characteristic sentence endings, hedging and modal inventory and the wider lexical repertoire are routed to L09 and Documents 12 and 16 outside this set, the profile excludes anime performance, and it states that no generated dialogue is evidence, so B is not supported.

Section VIII and the scene bank locate reading while his room is a peer hangout (V01 p-008 ¶20), libraries and museums (V02 p-006 ¶77), open laughter at Kurena slipping (V03 p-009 ¶195), fetching dry clothes for Anju and Dustin (V05), self-inclusion in the enjoyed leave (V07-L006), the paper-airplane deadpan (V08-L031), and Alter.1 cooking failure, forgotten birthday, ruin exploration, the bear for Frederica, hair braiding, the one-wall-away relief and the gift explained as his own wish. Food and palate are temporally indexed against the V14 sensory loss. Much of the domestic texture rests on Alter.1, which the profile labels supplemental and does not generalize beyond its placements, and no mainline domestic routine is described, so B is not supported.

Section VI gives nine directed Shin-to-target registers: Lena in six located phases (institutional V01-L028, trust without possession V04, need inside polite syntax V06-L036, economical confession V07-L054, Alter.1 ordinary intimacy, V11-L054 and V14-L197 care with an interpretive boundary); Raiden as answerable rather than deferential (V03-L022, V04, V13-L085); Frederica sibling-like with protection stopping short of authorship; Theo as trusted directness and care boundary (V14-L061); Kurena as comrade without reciprocal romance (V09 ¶412); Anju as practical unobtrusive care; Fido as wordless routinized relation; Annette as new relation with old history inside it; command as capability-sensitive delegation. Traps 13, 18, 19, 22 and 23 bound each. The registers are Shin-side only, the directed matrix rows and Document 10 are outside the set, and the Anju and Kurena relations rest on few scenes.

Section III.7 separates display threshold from emotional magnitude with located instances (Eugene V02-L034, the V09-L016 helplessness admission, the V14-L197/L199 admission that Rei's violence hurt, Alter.1 bodily relief), and the state-delta table in section VII records what changes and what stays stable in ten states. Interior claims are the profile's inferences from narration and behavior under its focalization control; the narrower trauma and grief authorities (Document 09, T07/T08) are outside the set, and the profile preserves T14-OQ-20 against Lena being sovereign over what he means. Specialist-supported interpretation, not a demonstrated interior model.

Section X locates premise attack (V01-L023 どこに、ですか？; V05-L028 retreat reframing; V14-L147 No Face rejected for eliminating freedom of heart), refusal inside polite morphology (聞けません; the V06 petition), rigidity when competence and self-expenditure align (V03-L022; V14-L055/L059 concealment), correction that lands (V04 delegation, V09-L004 request for peer correction, V13-L085 悪い。助かった, V14-L061 boundary with Theo) and explicit moral disgust. Section XI.5 distinguishes emergency interruption from permanent authority. Conflict evidence is concentrated on Lena, Raiden, Theo and command settings; disagreements with strangers or civilian institutions are thin, and no independent test exists in the set.

Section XIII restates values as conduct with located scenes: particularity in names (V02-L034), pride without exclusivity (V08-L032/L034), agency returned to Frederica and Rito (V11-L025), nonrevenge distinct from forgiveness (V11-L010), freedom as lived volition (V14-L147), political reasoning from his own fallibility (V14-L044). The prediction protocol marks forgiveness and lethal-mission volunteering as questions requiring qualification. The profile routes the normative argument to Documents 05-11 outside this set, the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS or IDEOLOGY, and no deliberation procedure for an unfamiliar moral choice is modeled, so C is not supported.

Sections V.6 and IX record deadpan trap-setting (Alter.1 part0011 ¶25-39), literal puncture (Alter.1 part0023 ¶11-55; V08-L031), rare open laughter (V03 p-009 ¶195; Alter.1 part0029 ¶39-42), embarrassment comedy (Alter.1 part0037 ¶16-38) and his being the target of peers' jokes, with constraints 11, 12 and 28 forbidding constant quips or uniform calm. The repertoire is specific and located, but mainline support is two scenes and the rest is Alter.1 supplemental, so B is not supported.

The profile declares the locked original-Japanese V01-V14 boundary, Alter.1 as audited supplemental, Alter.2 excluded and no V15+ inference, routes locators to the Phase-5 lock and quotation to Phase-8 and the EPUBs, and marks LOCATOR_GAP where a scene lies outside the frozen locator namespace. The 55-scene bank spans every volume and the supplement. The lock and verification artifacts are outside this evidence set, the boundary stops at V14 of a continuing series whose final arc is open, and the profile reads the corpus through the V2 scaffold rather than an exhaustive reread, so B is not supported.

Affirmative located limitations: the drunken-Lena deviation from composure (Alter.1 part0037), V14-L055/L059 concealment of sensory loss after acquiring reasons to live, V04 not rescuing Lena as the better protection, bad cooking and an unrefined palate, misreading Lena's Republic grief (Alter.1 part0052 ¶3-10), and the section XVIII audit that narrows or downgrades reserve, competence, protectiveness and discomfort with dependence. Thirty would-sound-wrong constraints and 24 traps give testable negatives. All of it lives inside one artifact and the audit is the project's own, so A is not supported.

Development is indexed by volume with Phase-5 locators; the profile forbids back-projecting the V14 sensory loss or minimizing it from the earlier bad palate, separates Annette's childhood relation from the present one, places Alter.1 scenes as pre-Federacy or low-pressure, fixes the V14 boundary as the latest state and keeps the T14 open questions open. No in-world dates are given and within-volume order is available only through locators.

conditions: Written-Japanese idiolect only, as the profile defines it; no anime acting, prosody or audiovisual staging is modeled.

The interlocutor is one of the attested relations (Lena, Raiden, Frederica, Theo, Kurena, Anju, Fido, Annette, peer commanders or subordinates) and the line uses that relation's attested register, including polite morphology toward Lena and plain speech toward Raiden.
The developmental boundary is named, and the propositions the line admits do not exceed what the semantic-admission sequence makes sayable at that boundary.

Japanese wording is limited to attested forms; new Japanese is not presented as characteristic, and English rendering keeps the low-excess, ellipsis-tolerant economy and the thirty would-sound-wrong constraints.
Output is non-canonical reconstruction output, never cited as evidence, and abstains where the profile records a lexical or state gap.
scenario_readiness.note: The profile supplies an interlocutor- and state-conditioned written register with attested forms and explicit would-sound-wrong constraints, which is more than fluency; it does not supply a sentence-ending or lexical inventory, excludes anime performance and states that generated dialogue is never evidence. READY would treat the project's own reconstruction gate as validation; NOT_READY would deny the located register model.

conditions: Chronology is fixed to one named V01-V14 developmental state, by default the V14 boundary state in which mature future language and unresolved role-based self-use coexist; no V15+, Alter.2 or anime state is used.
The interlocutor is an attested relation in its attested register, or a stranger only in the adult, officer, child, technician or peer roles the profile says he handles without social panic.

The situation closely matches one of the profile's high-confidence classes: operational crisis, trusted-peer correction, ordinary quiet time, giving care, the Lena private register, Frederica household life, or embarrassing intimacy.

Output is a behavioral tendency with the profile's qualification language (typically, with this interlocutor, under this pressure), abstaining on the open domains: postwar vocation, reversibility of the sensory loss, the ability after the war, Undertaker in peace, a settled disclosure practice, and forgiveness.
No institution, technology, culture or relationship state absent from the V01-V14 corpus is introduced, and no readiness is inherited from the profile's CMR-9 verdict.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named V01-V14 state, by default the V14 boundary state after the sensory-loss disclosure, the No Face rejection and the admission that Rei's violence hurt; earlier states only when explicitly selected.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Lena, Raiden, Frederica, Theo, Kurena, Anju, Fido, Annette, or peer commanders and subordinates in their attested registers; strangers only in roles the profile attests.
setting_constraints: Operational crisis, peer correction, ordinary quiet time, caregiving, the Lena private register, the Frederica household or embarrassing intimacy
No crossover institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the V01-V14 corpus
Alter.1-only behaviors stay labeled supplemental and are not generalized
Open domains end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section XX supplies a bounded prediction protocol with high-confidence classes, predictions requiring qualification and a rule to model from the intersection of state, task, relationship, body and answer-space. Readiness is conditional because the profile itself limits prediction to situations overlapping attested conditions, states that it weakens rapidly outside them, and its reconstruction test is the project's own. READY would license the unconstrained role-play the profile forbids; NOT_READY would deny an explicit protocol built for this use.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: reading, libraries, museums, ruins and records, parallel activity in a shared room, card games, celebrations, gifts fitted to the recipient's taste, household life with Frederica, and low-pressure teasing.
Alter.1-only behaviors (cooking failure, the forgotten birthday, hair braiding, the drunken-Lena scene, the birthday gift) stay labeled supplemental and are not generalized across mainline contexts.
Food, palate and sleep are indexed to the developmental boundary, with the V14 sensory loss neither back-projected nor minimized.
Tactile affection remains relationship- and consent-specific and is not generalized.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary capacity is one of the profile's high-confidence domains, but much of its domestic texture is Alter.1 supplemental and the profile forbids generalizing it. READY would ignore that labeling; NOT_READY would deny repeated mainline ordinary scenes.

The profile records values as conduct and marks forgiveness and lethal-mission volunteering as predictions requiring qualification, but routes the normative argument to specialist documents outside this set and supplies no deliberation procedure for an unfamiliar moral choice; the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS. CONDITIONAL would turn value tendencies into a deliberation model; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located value scenes. This bounds the evidence set, not Shin's moral life.

conditions: Shin-side reconstruction only; Lena's side and the bilateral synthesis belong to Document 10, which is outside this evidence set.

Chronology is fixed to one phase: institutional V01, trust without possession V04, need inside polite syntax V06, economical confession V07, Alter.1 ordinary intimacy, or the V11/V14 care-and-boundary state.
Polite morphology and verbal economy are retained; romantic speech stays direct but not florid, and Lena is neither his sole reason to live nor irrelevant to his future.
Kurena's feelings are not reciprocated, embodied intimacy stays consent- and relation-bound, and no V15+ outcome is asserted.
scenario_readiness.note: The Lena relation is the most richly located register in the profile, with six phases and explicit traps. READY would ignore that the profile is Shin-side only and that the ordinary intimacy rests on Alter.1; NOT_READY would deny the located phases.

conditions: Military and operational contexts of the kind narrated for the Eighty-Six and the Federacy: concise capability-sensitive delegation, deliberate affective compartmentalization in command crisis (V11 p-018 ¶35), peer-commander correction (V09-L004), extraction requests when he cannot move (V04-L032), and rejection of orders that make someone disposable.
No tactical doctrine, technology or institutional claim is drawn from the profile; it covers behavior only.
The V14 concealment of sensory loss is retained as a live vulnerability; disclosure is not modeled as reliable when it threatens his role.
No postwar vocation or peacetime professional state is asserted.
scenario_readiness.note: Operational command behavior is well located, but the profile confines itself to behavior and routes military-system claims to Document 07 and T05 outside this set. READY would overstate; NOT_READY would deny the located command register.

known_limits.statement: The profile's source boundary is locked original-Japanese V01-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental and Alter.2 excluded; no V15+ material is inferred, the final arc is open, and the T14 open questions on postwar vocation, medical honesty, Undertaker after the war, the ability after the war and the limit of Lena's interpretive authority (T14-OQ-16 to T14-OQ-20) are preserved rather than resolved.

V14 shows Shin concealing long-term loss of taste and smell because treatment threatened his role, which the profile reads as proof that role-based self-use remains an active vulnerability after he has acquired reasons to live; the admission that Rei's violence hurt is a major admission, not resolution of the trauma. A healed-Shin model is forbidden.

The voice model is a written-Japanese idiolect and discourse model; anime acting, prosody and staging are excluded, no generated dialogue or hypothetical reconstruction is evidence, and the profile warns that synthetic Japanese must not fill a lexical gap.

Cooking failure, the forgotten birthday, ruin exploration, the bear for Frederica, hair braiding, the drunken-Lena scene, the one-wall-away relief and the birthday gift come from Alter.1, whose supplemental status must remain visible; traits appearing only there are not generalized across mainline contexts.

The profile declares itself derived reconstruction reference promoted by CMR-9, subordinate to the Japanese primary source and the narrower canonical V2 authorities in any conflict; LOCATOR_GAP scenes carry an EPUB route but no Phase-5 locator, and its own QA verdict is a project label rather than independent validation.

Every relationship register is Shin-to-target; bilateral synthesis belongs to Document 10 and the directed matrix. Kurena's romantic investment is unreciprocated in the locked corpus, Annette is a new relation with irreversible history rather than recovered childhood, and Fido is not equipment.

The CMR method, the CMR-9 promotion audit, the diagnostic locator index, the relationship matrix, the crosswalk, ledgers L01/L02/L09, Documents 02, 09, 10, 12 and 16, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the profile's locators and quotations were not rechecked here and no independent or held-out reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
